free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the patient has a high-risk PI-RADS 5 lesion and a concerning PSA velocity of 0.39 ng/mL/yr, which contradicts the prior negative biopsy. The decision is driven by the PI-RADS 5 finding and the rapid PSA rise from 4.0 ng/mL to 7.4 ng/mL over the last year. The statistical prior suggested biopsy, which is strongly supported by the specific imaging and trend data.
